review: 701.61a-1: no variant tested that forage exiles only from the forager's own graveyard; added variant opponent_graveyard (three cards in B's graveyard, cannot forage).
701.61a-2: no variant tested that forage sacrifices only a Food the forager controls; added variant opponent_food (Food controlled by B, cannot forage).

scenarios.title: Foraging exiles three cards from the forager's graveyard

setup.notes: A controls no Food, so exiling three graveyard cards is the only way to forage.

decisions: A casts Treetop Sentries, tapping all four Forests.
Both players pass; Treetop Sentries resolves and enters the battlefield, and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves. A chooses to forage and exiles the three Grizzly Bears from A's graveyard as the cost.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: three_cards
variants.expected: A's graveyard is empty and the three Grizzly Bears are in exile. A drew one card, so A's hand holds one Forest and A's library holds one Forest. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.delta: A's graveyard holds only two Grizzly Bears instead of three.
variants.expected: Foraging is impossible: A's two Grizzly Bears stay in the graveyard, nothing is exiled, A draws no card and A's hand is empty. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

variants.label: opponent_graveyard
variants.delta: The three Grizzly Bears are in B's graveyard instead of A's; A's graveyard is empty.
variants.expected: Foraging is impossible: the three Grizzly Bears stay in B's graveyard, nothing is exiled, A draws no card and A's hand is empty. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: Treetop Sentries implements the forage as an optional Cost$ Forage on an AB$ Draw inside its enters trigger. Forge's Forage cost lets the payer choose between exiling three graveyard cards and sacrificing a Food; with no Food only the exile branch is offered.

scenarios.title: Foraging sacrifices a Food

setup.notes: The Food is a Food artifact token (Forge script c_a_food_sac, named Food Token). A's graveyard holds only two cards, so exiling three is not possible and sacrificing the Food is the only way to forage.

decisions: A casts Treetop Sentries, tapping all four Forests.
Both players pass; Treetop Sentries resolves and enters the battlefield, and its enters trigger goes on the stack.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves. A chooses to forage and sacrifices the Food as the cost.
Both players pass with the stack empty.

variants.label: food_present
variants.expected: The Food token is sacrificed and ceases to exist. A's two Grizzly Bears stay in the graveyard and nothing is exiled. A drew one card, so A's hand holds one Forest. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

variants.label: no_food
variants.expected: Foraging is impossible: A's two Grizzly Bears stay in the graveyard, nothing is exiled, A draws no card and A's hand is empty. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

variants.label: opponent_food
variants.delta: The Food token is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: Foraging is impossible: B's Food token stays on the battlefield, A's two Grizzly Bears stay in the graveyard, nothing is exiled, A draws no card and A's hand is empty. Treetop Sentries is on the battlefield.

scenarios.forge_notes: The Food token is not listed in cards because tokens are not in the cardsfolder. In Forge the token's script is c_a_food_sac (Name: Food Token, Types: Artifact Food).

scenarios.title: An activated ability with forage in its cost needs three graveyard cards or a Food

setup.notes: A controls no Food and no other permanent. The ability in question is Thornvault Forager's '{T}, Forage: Add two mana in any combination of colors.'

decisions: A considers activating Thornvault Forager's '{T}, Forage: Add two mana in any combination of colors.' ability with the Forager untapped.

variants.label: three_cards
variants.expected: The activation is legal: the forage cost can be paid by exiling the three Grizzly Bears from A's graveyard.

variants.label: two_cards
variants.delta: A's graveyard holds only two Grizzly Bears instead of three.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal: the forage cost cannot be paid with two graveyard cards and no Food. The Forager's plain '{T}: Add {G}.' ability remains legal.

scenarios.forge_notes: Thornvault Forager's second mana ability has Cost$ T Forage.
